verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own marketing lists an 'Automations' product and a 'Super Agent' that 'Works 24/7' and can take delegated tasks, which points to first-party background automation. However, the evidence is marketing labels only, with no documentation of how automations are configured, triggered, scheduled or run unattended. missing for 10: documented automation builder (triggers/conditions/actions), recurring schedule support, details on how the agent runs autonomously, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
